_doc: Digimon model database for set planning. One record per distinct Digimon (Wikimon page) that has at least one model on The Models Resource in tools/convert/downloads-moved/dt_catalog.json. Level, attribute, fields, type, evolution links and moves come from Wikimon (wikimon.net, fetched 2026-10-15 through its API); evolvesFrom/evolvesTo are the bolded (main) links on Wikimon, or the first five links when none are bold. Names are the English names used by the catalog. stageBand is the slot the Digimon can fill in a 3-stage line (rookie / champion / ultimate / mega). animated is true when at least one source is from a game whose rips carry animation clips (see animationCheck). recolorOnly marks Digimon that only exist as a second texture inside another Digimon's model file (e.g. BlackAgumon in "Agumon / BlackAgumon"). used lists where the Digimon already appears: in-game (js/data.js DT.LINES), downloaded (tools/convert/rips or the NEW/EXTRA tables in convert-all.cjs) or planned (tools/convert/new-chains.json only). unitEligible / unitSources: the Digimon has a model from a Cyber Sleuth-family game (Cyber Sleuth CE, Digimon Links, Next Order, Re:Digitize, Time Stranger), the only sources allowed for board units. Each source has cyberSleuthFamily and downloadStatus. setUsage lists the set plans that use the Digimon (stage 0 = Rookie, 1 = middle form, 2 = final).

animationCheck.method: Counted glTF animations in every converted rip in models/src (rip_*.glb) with gltf-transform, and looked for AnimationStack records in unconverted FBX files in tools/convert/rips/x.

results.links: animated: 82 of 82 converted rips have clips (10-14 clips each)
results.cs: animated: 29 of 29 converted rips have clips (11-35 clips)
results.nc: animated: 8 of 8 converted rips have clips (16-23 clips); unconverted FBX (Floramon, Kiwimon, Blossomon, Mojyamon, KingChessmon, PawnChessmon) also contain animation stacks
results.rearise: animated: 2 of 2 converted rips have clips (12-13); unconverted FBX (Bearmon, Grizzlymon, Chibomon, Azulongmon) contain animation stacks
results.masters: static: 0 of 6 converted rips have clips; unconverted Masters rips are OBJ only
results.ts: static: Gizamon (the only Time Stranger rip) has no clips
results.dw2: not sampled (no rips downloaded); treated as unknown
results.dwnext: not sampled (no rips downloaded); treated as unknown
